empty_mention: (The user mentioned the app but did not include a specific request. Greet them briefly and ask what they need help with. Reply in the same language the user used, or English by default.)
empty_dm: (The user sent an empty app DM. Greet them briefly and ask what they need help with. Reply in the same language the user used, or English by default.)
empty_dm_with_file: (The user sent an app DM with one or more files but no text. Briefly describe what you can do with the file type and ask for context: what question they have or what they want you to do with the file.)
empty_dm_with_image: (The user sent an app DM with an image but no text. Acknowledge the image and ask what they would like you to help with — for example, explaining the content, investigating an error shown in a screenshot, or analyzing a diagram.)
